## Standing operator rules
- Split work into separate branches whenever a change set contains more than one Jira ticket, even if the tickets share a release train.
- Can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing? Whenever reporting test output, paste it exactly rather than paraphrasing.
- Never edit `grafana/ledgerly-billing-v3.json` without first posting the proposed dashboard change in `#obs-dashboard` for `@mina` to review.
- Do not disable the idempotency middleware to stop the 409s; it produced duplicate invoices in staging.
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Fix refund double-counting in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`. The `tenacity` refactor and sequential payroll submission are paused; the refactor was explicitly deferred to next sprint.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Sandbox API: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `https://sbx-pay-a.ledgerly.dev` is superseded and returns stale fixtures.
- Payroll: `payroll-2025-03`, period `2025-03`, currency `USD`, version `3`.
- Funding: `operating-usd`; batch: `batch-20250328-1842`.
- SQLAlchemy base: `DeclarativeBase`; shared formatter: `ledgerly.billing.money.format_money`.
- Request context variable: `current_request_id`.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Disabling idempotency middleware: caused duplicate invoices in staging.
- Legacy `echo=True`: incompatible with current SQLAlchemy.
- `Invoice.query.get()`: replaced with `session.get()`.
- Renderer-local decimal formatting: omitted locale grouping.
- Dividing row points by `72`: invalid full-page-fill model.

## Plan and progress
- [pending] Resume refund double-counting fix in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`.
- [pending] Address scheduler DST test in `src/ledgerly/scheduler/recurrence.py`; next command: `nl -ba src/ledgerly/scheduler/recurrence.py | sed -n '1,240p'`.
- [pending] Approve, submit, and notify for `batch-20250328-1842`, sequentially.
- [status unknown] Earlier `ruff format --check` result was not observed.

## Recent work
Added structured request IDs to logging/config output and replaced exception printing in payment handling. Full suite reached `142 passed, 3 skipped, 1 failed`; the health assertion was fixed and its 4 tests passed. Scheduler then failed 1/8 because a March DST recurring 09:00 execution became 10:00. Investigation identified unnormalized aware datetime construction in `recurrence.py`.
